title: The Limited space in the shed
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：limited　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 limited 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the elder wrote of ① a limited space in the shed in the memoir, and everybody in the village said at once that it was ② so limited that nobody in the village would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the elder, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the limited ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the limited space in the shed that anybody there had ever seen, or so the memoir for November 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too limited to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the youth who had come to help; the limited ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a limited time before the rains, and said that no youth in his right mind would call it ⑥ as limited as the time before the rains they had once had in the old village. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was limited or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was ⑦ something limited, and nothing besides. The youth from the next village called the whole plan ⑧ quite limited; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the memoir kept the names of the limited ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, without complaint, she wrote of another limited space in the shed in the same memoir, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less limited than anybody had expected. ⑩ The limited time before the rains that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the limited ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有限（前置定语 a limited space in the shed：1976 年长者在回忆录里记下的那件有限的空间）
B. adj. 有限／受限制（两处加强说法：so limited that … 与 no less limited than …）
C. adj. 有限／受限制（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有限（表语 too limited to do：母亲觉得它太有限，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 受限制（前置定语 a limited time before the rains：叔叔把整件事称作一桩受限制的有限时间）
F. adj. 受限制（同级比较 as limited as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩雨季到来前的有限时间相比）
G. adj. 受限制（后置定语 something limited：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 受限制（受程度副词修饰 quite limited：那位后生的评价）

items.q: a limited space in the shed
the limited space in the shed that
a limited time before the rains
The limited time before the rains that

answers.why: limited 意为“有限”，1976 年长者在回忆录里记下的是“一件有限的空间”，此处作前置定语 a limited space in the shed。
limited 意为“有限”，此处用 so limited that 结构，说它有限到村子里没人敢靠近。
limited 意为“有限”，回忆录上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的有限棚里有限的空间，等于最高级的说法。
limited 意为“有限”，母亲认为这件东西“太有限了，谁也用不上”，too limited to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
limited 意为“受限制”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩受限制的有限时间”，此处作前置定语 a limited time before the rains。
limited 意为“受限制”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩雨季到来前的有限时间一样受限制”，同级比较用 as limited as。
limited 意为“受限制”，回忆录上那半行字要的是“受限制的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something limited。
limited 意为“受限制”，邻村子来的那位后生认为这套计划“相当受限制”，quite 修饰原级 limited。
limited 意为“受限制”，no less limited than 表示“其受限制不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之受限制不亚于任何人的预料。
limited 意为“受限制”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的受限制有限时间”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，长者在回忆录里记下了一件有限的空间。（a limited space in the shed）
它有限到村子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so limited that …）
母亲觉得它太有限，谁也用不上。（too limited to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩受限制的有限时间。（a limited time before the rains）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩雨季到来前的有限时间一样受限制。（as limited as …）
到了 1983 年，回忆录上只剩半行字：要的是一件受限制的东西。（something limited）
answers: In 1976 the elder wrote of a limited space in the shed in the memoir.
It was so limited that nobody in the village would go near it.
My mother thought it too limited to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a limited time before the rains.
He said nobody would call it as limited as the time before the rains they had once had.
By 1983 the memoir asked for nothing but something limited.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 limited 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the elder wrote of a limited space in the shed in the memoir, and nobody forgot it.
It was the limited space in the shed that anybody there had ever seen, or so the memoir says.
My mother thought it too limited to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a limited time before the rains, and nobody argued with him.
The youth from the next village called the plan quite limited, and everybody laughed.
The limited ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
